title: Baked Radish with Creamy Wine Sauce
description: A rich and creamy sauce pairs perfectly with the earthy flavor of baked radish in this French-inspired dish.
instructions: Toss radish slices with butter and season with salt and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until radish is tender and lightly browned.
In a saucepan, combine wine and garlic. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce wine by half, then stir in heavy cream. Bring to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened.
To serve, place baked radish on a plate and spoon creamy wine sauce over the top.
